description: This file defines the class Smarty_Resource_Mysqls, which implements a custom resource for Smarty templates backed by a MySQL database. It includes database connection setup, preparing queries, and methods to fetch template content and modification timestamps from the database.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Mysqls
classes.description: A class extending Smarty_Resource_Custom to implement template resource fetching from a MySQL database, including database connection and fetching logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database connection using PDO and prepares the fetch statement.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Retrieves template source and modification time from the database for a given template name.

calls: $this->db->prepare('SELECT modified, source FROM templates WHERE name = :name')
